question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Gross margin (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Management explicitly signaled on the Aug 26 2026 Q2 FY27 call that gross margin bottoms in Q4 FY27 at 71-72% (memory costs), recovering to 72-73% in FY28. NVIDIA guides as point +/-50bp, so 71.5% is the natural midpoint; GAAP and non-GAAP have been guided identically recently (74.0% both for Q3). Downside risk from memory prices rising further (commitments jumped $119B->$279B) and a possible small GAAP-below-non-GAAP gap; upside from mix/pricing. No market prices Q4 guidance; Polymarket contracts are on Q3 actual non-GAAP GM (83% on 73-75%, ~$2.4k volume) — a different contract, used only as a check that the Q3 guide is reliable.
calls.dossier:
- NVIDIA Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26 2026): Q2 GAAP GM 75.0%, non-GAAP 75.0%; Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP and non-GAAP GM 74.0% +/-50bp; revenue $108.0B +/-2%.
- Q2 FY27 call/coverage (CNBC, The Elec, Yahoo, Aug 2026): management expects GM to decline and bottom in Q4 FY27 (Nov-Jan) at 71%-72%, citing memory prices that exceeded prior expectations and are headed higher next year; FY28 GM projected to recover to 72-73%, contingent on planned product price increases. Kress: 'We want to be direct about this.'
- Earlier FY27 target was 'mid-70s'; the Aug 2026 statement is a downward revision from that.
- CFO commentary (SEC 8-K, Aug 2026): purchase commitments rose $119B -> $279B, mostly memory procurement; no written Q4 GM figure in the commentary.
- The coverage does not say whether the 71-72% range is GAAP or non-GAAP; recent guides have set GAAP = non-GAAP (Q3: both 74.0%); historically GAAP ran ~0.1-0.2pp below non-GAAP.
- NVIDIA guidance format: single point +/-50bp; resolution uses the midpoint (the point value).
- Vera Rubin shipments began August 2026; expected ~20% of Data Center revenue in Q3 (new-product ramp can weigh on margin).
- HBM4 est. ~$550/stack vs ~$300 for HBM3E (siliconanalysts).
- Oct 23 2026: NVDA fell 4.4% on AI financing fears (FX Leaders); no Q4 GM update found between Aug and Oct.
- Resolves off the GAAP GM midpoint in the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release (expected around Nov 2026), not non-GAAP and not call commentary.
- Event window: single publication event, the Q3 FY27 release (scheduled ~Nov 2026); as of Oct 23 2026 the release has not happened.
- Markets: no market found on Q4 guidance; Polymarket only has Q3 actual non-GAAP GM bins.
- Searched for but not found: any intra-quarter margin update from management, or sell-side consensus for the Q4 GM guide.
calls.reference_class: NVIDIA next-quarter GM guidance relative to the level management pre-signaled one quarter earlier (e.g., the FY26 'mid-70s exit' guide that was delivered as 74.8-75.0%)

calls.reconciliation: All three runs agree on the facts: the 71-72% Q4 bottom stated on the Aug 26 call, repeated in an Oct 9 article; GAAP equal to non-GAAP in recent guides; no update found through Oct 23; no matching market. Their differences are only in tail width and skew, which are judgment calls. I carry forward the shared 71.5 anchor with a mild downside skew and a width near the middle of the runs' range (1.15-1.5). No web access on this run, so nothing new was checked.

disagreements.verdict: Took 72.1: upside needs earlier pricing actions or memory easing, and the near-term evidence points the other way
